title: Poem for the Club by Jack Crawford
alt_text: Poem for the Club by Jack Crawford, written in southwestern dialect.
creator: The Thirteen Club
description: The poem, written in Captain Jack Crawford’s signature dialect prose, begins with Southwestern men in a saloon agreeing to form a Thirteen Club of their own “jes’ like those New York blokes,” and ends with all 13 men experiencing absurdly bad luck and giving into superstitious belief after all. Several of the poem’s victims suffer injury, while others comedically lose their wives or girlfriends to other men. In contrast, the NY Club trounces superstition in a “bold, defiant” physical fight and emerges unscathed despite their ritual tempting of fate.
